findings.highlight: I never thought I would make it back alive
findings.evidenceJa: 無事に帰ってこれると思っていなかった
findings.governingReading: I had not expected us to return safely
findings.explanation: The English promotes danger to a certainty that Shirou expected death.

findings.highlight: EhI have to take my clothes off
findings.evidenceJa: え服脱ぐのか
findings.governingReading: What, I have to take my clothes off?
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the interjection and pronoun.

findings.evidenceJa: かすかに息を呑んでいた
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka faintly catches her breath
findings.explanation: The restrained, nearly inaudible reaction becomes a full gasp.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな憎まれ口を叩きながらも
findings.governingReading: even while speaking those barbed words
findings.explanation: The friction between Rin’s harsh speech and gentle touch is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: ものすごく優しい指遣いで傷に触れていく
findings.governingReading: touches the wound with extraordinarily gentle fingers
findings.explanation: The intensity and tactile manner of Rin’s care disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 内心で呟いて火照った頭を叩く
findings.governingReading: I mutter inwardly and strike my overheated head
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces Shirou’s words and physical action with unsupported self-criticism.

findings.highlight: Just use styptic and roll up the bandage
findings.evidenceJa: 化膿止め塗って
findings.governingReading: apply anti-suppuration ointment and rewrap the bandage
findings.explanation: The requested anti-infection treatment disappears, and rewrapping becomes “roll up.”

findings.evidenceJa: 恨みなら骨髄まで染み渡ってる
findings.governingReading: my grudge has soaked me to the marrow
findings.explanation: Rin’s vivid comic declaration of deep resentment is replaced by a vague retort.

findings.highlight: I stay quiet since I know Tohsaka is seriously treating my wound
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は本気で傷を看てくれている
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is earnestly tending my wound
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents Shirou’s silence and a causal explanation.

findings.evidenceJa: えま、まあ、それならいいけど
findings.governingReading: W-well, if that is so, fine
findings.explanation: Collapsed spacing produces an accidental “Ehw” at the start of Rin’s reply.

findings.highlight: It’ll heal as long as I treat it
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが看る以上は、きっかり治してみせる
findings.governingReading: since I am treating it, I will make absolutely sure it heals
findings.explanation: Rin’s personal resolve and agency become a passive conditional guarantee.

findings.highlight: what they’re teaching in the cooking class
findings.evidenceJa: 調理実習で女子に何を教えているのか
findings.governingReading: what they teach the girls in our cooking practicum
findings.explanation: The gendered school joke about Rin’s domestic education disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: お茶碗はそろそろ空っぽ
findings.governingReading: her rice bowl is nearly empty
findings.explanation: The meal’s concrete Japanese table setting changes.

findings.evidenceJa: 気合いが削がれる
findings.governingReading: my resolve is sapped
findings.explanation: An effect of Rin’s casual delivery is recast as her intentional action against Shirou.

findings.highlight: I try to get myself together
findings.evidenceJa: 丹田に力を入れた
findings.governingReading: I gather strength in my lower abdomen
findings.explanation: The bodily image of Shirou bracing his center is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方が好き
findings.governingReading: I love the ideal of being an ally of justice
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defining moral ideal is reduced to liking a pop-culture character type.

findings.highlight: I’m not a Master or that I’ve lost Saber
findings.evidenceJa: マスターでなくなっても、セイバーがいなくなっても
findings.governingReading: even if I cease to be a Master and even if Saber is gone
findings.explanation: Hypothetical future losses become claims about Shirou’s current state.

findings.evidenceJa: 空返事
findings.governingReading: a perfunctory reply
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate noncommittal response becomes inattention.

findings.evidenceJa: 死ぬような目に遭ってしまう人がいる
findings.governingReading: there are people who will be put through mortal danger
findings.explanation: Possible victims facing death are promoted into people presently dying.

findings.highlight: the part of me that I don’t even know aboutand most of all
findings.evidenceJa: 知らない衛宮士郎を見抜くような真摯さ
findings.governingReading: a sincerity that seems to see through the Emiya Shirou even I do not know
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses two clauses at the emotional center of Rin’s insight.

findings.evidenceJa: えあ、うん
findings.governingReading: Uh—ah, yes
findings.explanation: Collapsed spacing turns Shirou’s flustered interjections into “Ehoh.”

findings.evidenceJa: 妙に気合いをいれた
findings.governingReading: strangely steels herself
findings.explanation: Rin’s visible effort to muster courage before confessing is generalized.

findings.highlight: So it’s fine if we stay together, right
findings.evidenceJa: そっちだって一緒にいても問題ないでしょ、実際
findings.governingReading: and in truth, you have no objection to being together either, do you
findings.explanation: Rin’s appeal to Shirou’s reciprocal desire is weakened into generic permission.

findings.evidenceJa: 望むところだ
findings.governingReading: that is exactly what I want—bring it on
findings.explanation: Shirou’s eager acceptance of Rin’s tyranny becomes mere indifference.

findings.highlight: fill it from the rice cooker
findings.evidenceJa: ばっくんと炊飯ジャーを開けて、とにかくしゃもじを振るって
findings.governingReading: fling open the rice cooker and hurriedly wield the rice paddle
findings.explanation: The comic physical energy of Shirou’s elation disappears.
